tytul: Pontack sauce: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for pontack, a historical sauce of elderberries and vinegar that is aged before use.

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to MU Extension, elderberries in a study had an average pH of 4.92 (range 4.73–5.19), while the maximum pH for safe canning of fruits and fruit products is 4.60; no research shows how much acid must be added to preserve elderberry products safely, and Extension recommends freezing the berries or juice instead.
Raw elderberries may contain elevated levels of toxic compounds, so always cook elderberries before eating them.
Elder stems and leaves contain higher levels of toxins, so remove them before processing.

akapity: JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for an elderberry vinegar sauce and no checked source for how long such a sauce can be kept.
Aging the sauce means keeping it for a long time without a tested recipe.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for pontack sauce from a checked source.
